current_prompt.body:
READ the 7x7 Latin square grid with cells marked 0 as input
SOLVE the puzzle by filling all zero cells so that each row contains each number from 1 to 7 exactly once
SOLVE the puzzle by filling all zero cells so that each column contains each number from 1 to 7 exactly once
VERIFY that the completed grid is a permutation of {1,…,7} in every row
VERIFY that the completed grid is a permutation of {1,…,7} in every column

FOR each identified zero cell

AND does not already appear in the cell's column
SELECT a candidate that satisfies both row and column constraints
ENDFOR
VERIFY that each row contains each number from 1 to 7 exactly once
VERIFY that each column contains each number from 1 to 7 exactly once
